policies.name: clubes_select_miembro
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM club_miembros cm
  WHERE ((cm.club_id = clubes.id_club) AND (cm.user_id = auth.uid()))))

policies.name: clubes_update_miembro_admin
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM club_miembros cm
  WHERE ((cm.club_id = clubes.id_club) AND (cm.user_id = auth.uid()) AND (cm.rol = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::text, 'admin'::text])))))
policies.with_check:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM club_miembros cm
  WHERE ((cm.club_id = clubes.id_club) AND (cm.user_id = auth.uid()) AND (cm.rol = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::text, 'admin'::text])))))
